verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for an AI app-building SaaS like v0, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion of chats or projects, account data deletion, or training opt-out. The only nearby item is API export for backup and migration, which is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
